svg.aria-label: Echo, Executive Computer Heuristic Operator: a local-first autonomous agent runtime for macOS. Loop: perceive, plan, act, verify, recover, learn. It sees the screen through screenshots, OCR and accessibility APIs, targets controls semantically, streams voice, and keeps an agent journal that tracks verified, uncertain, partial and failed operations separately. Brains switch live between Claude, Gemini and local Ollama.
